newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin names Augustine chairman.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin names Augustine chairman.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Thursday it named Norman Augustine, its vice chairman and chief executive officer, as chairman, effective January 1, 1997.
Augustine, 61, would replace Daniel Tellep, 65, who will step down as chairman at year-end, but remain on Lockheed's board of directors, the company said.

The move is part of a succession plan set up in the original August 1994 agreement to merge Lockheed and Martin Marietta. It said it had not yet named a successor to the vice chairman and CEO position.
Augustine became president of Lockheed Martin after the merger. He had been chairman of Martin Marietta from 1988 to 1995, and chief executive officer from 1987 to 1995, the company said.
Before the merger, Tellep was chairman and CEO of Lockheed from 1989 to 1995, then served as Lockheed Martin's first chairman and CEO, the company said.
